designNotes: Two time points for a session without full check-in: end of day -> PT; 24 hours -> Studio Manager task.

cases.title: A session without full check-in is notified to its PT at the end of the day and to the Studio Manager after 24 hours

steps.action: Leave a booked session without a full check-in until the end of its day
steps.expected: The PT receives 1 notice for that session
A task is created for the Studio Manager

assumptions: "End of the day" is taken as the end of the session's calendar day; the sources do not give a time.
cases.manualReason: Depends on time passing; needs a controllable clock.
